Project registry — projects.yaml schema and loader.\n//!\n//! Supports two shapes:\n//!\n//! **v0.2 (canonical)** — explicit workspace list:\n//! ```yaml\n//! version: \"0.2\"\n//! projects:\n//!   - name: ibkr-mcp\n//!     workspaces:\n//!       - path: /home/coding/ibkr-mcp\n//!         role: primary\n//! ```\n//!\n//! **v0.1 shorthand** — single `path:` field, role defaults to `primary`:\n//! ```yaml\n//! projects:\n//!   - name: ibkr-mcp\n//!     path: /home/coding/ibkr-mcp\n//! ```\n//!\n//! Loading normalises v0.1 to v0.2 in memory. `migrate()` rewrites the file\n//! to v0.2 format, preserving all data.\n\nuse std::collections::HashSet;\nuse std::path::Path;\nuse std::{fmt, fs};\n\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\n\nuse crate::error::{AgentScribeError, Result};\n\n/// Schema version emitted by `save()` and `migrate()`.\npub const SCHEMA_VERSION: &str = \"0.2\";\n\n// ── Public types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// A workspace directory associated with a project.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Workspace {\n    pub path: String,\n    pub role: String,\n}\n\n/// A project entry in the registry.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct Project {\n    pub name: String,\n    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub label: Option<String>,\n    #[serde(skip_serializing_if = \"Option::is_none\")]\n    pub color: Option<String>,\n    pub workspaces: Vec<Workspace>,\n}\n\n/// Parsed and validated projects.yaml.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]\npub struct ProjectsFile {\n    pub version: String,\n    pub projects: Vec<Project>,\n}\n\n/// A non-fatal warning produced during loading.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ProjectWarning {\n    pub project: String,\n    pub message: String,\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for ProjectWarning {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"project '{}': {}\", self.project, self.message)\n    }\n}\n\n// ── Private deserialization types (raw/unvalidated) ───────────────────────────\n\n#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]\nstruct ProjectRaw {\n    name: String,\n    label: Option<String>,\n    color: Option<String>,\n    /// v0.1 shorthand — single workspace path; role defaults to `primary`.\n    path: Option<String>,\n    /// v0.2 explicit workspace list.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    workspaces: Vec<Workspace>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]\nstruct ProjectsFileRaw {\n    version: Option<String>,\n    #[serde(default)]\n    projects: Vec<ProjectRaw>,\n}\n\n// ── Validation helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Accepts `#RGB` and `#RRGGBB` (case-insensitive).\nfn is_valid_hex_color(s: &str) -> bool {\n    let Some(hex) = s.strip_prefix('#') else {\n        return false;\n    };\n    matches!(hex.len(), 3 | 6) && hex.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit())\n}\n\n// ── Normalisation ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nfn normalize_project(raw: ProjectRaw) -> Result<(Project, Vec<ProjectWarning>)> {\n    let mut warnings = Vec::new();\n\n    let workspaces: Vec<Workspace> = match (raw.path.as_deref(), raw.workspaces.is_empty()) {\n        (Some(_), false) => {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::Projects(format!(\n                \"project '{}': 'path' shorthand and 'workspaces' cannot both be specified\",\n                raw.name\n            )));\n        }\n        (Some(path), true) => {\n            vec![Workspace {\n                path: path.to_string(),\n                role: \"primary\".to_string(),\n            }]\n        }\n        (None, false) => raw.workspaces,\n        (None, true) => {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::Projects(format!(\n                \"project '{}': must have at least one workspace \\\n                 (use 'path' shorthand or 'workspaces' list)\",\n                raw.name\n            )));\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Validate workspace paths and roles are non-empty.\n    for (i, ws) in workspaces.iter().enumerate() {\n        if ws.path.trim().is_empty() {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::Projects(format!(\n                \"project '{}': workspace[{}] has an empty path\",\n                raw.name, i\n            )));\n        }\n        if ws.role.trim().is_empty() {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::Projects(format!(\n                \"project '{}': workspace[{}] has an empty role\",\n                raw.name, i\n            )));\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Warn (but allow) duplicate roles within a project.\n    let mut seen_roles: HashSet<&str> = HashSet::new();\n    for ws in &workspaces {\n        if !seen_roles.insert(ws.role.as_str()) {\n            warnings.push(ProjectWarning {\n                project: raw.name.clone(),\n                message: format!(\"duplicate workspace role '{}'\", Ok((\n        Project {\n            name: raw.name,\n            label: raw.label,\n            color: raw.color,\n            workspaces,\n        },\n        warnings,\n    ))\n}\n\n// ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Load and validate `projects.yaml`, returning the canonical file and any\n/// non-fatal warnings.\n///\n/// v0.1 shorthand is normalised to v0.2 in memory; the file on disk is not\n/// modified. Use [`migrate`] to rewrite the file.\npub fn load_with_warnings(path: &Path) -> Result<(ProjectsFile, Vec<ProjectWarning>)> {\n    let content = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|e| {\n        AgentScribeError::Projects(format!(\"cannot read {}: {}\", path.display(), e))\n    })?;\n\n    let raw: ProjectsFileRaw = serde_yaml::from_str(&content).map_err(|e| {\n        AgentScribeError::Projects(format!(\"YAML parse error in {}: {}\", path.display(), e))\n    })?;\n\n    let mut projects = Vec::with_capacity(raw.projects.len());\n    let mut all_warnings = Vec::new();\n    let mut seen_names: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();\n\n    for project_raw in raw.projects {\n        if !seen_names.insert(project_raw.name.clone()) {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::Projects(format!(\n                \"duplicate project name '{}'\",\n                project_raw.name\n            )));\n        }\n        let (project, warnings) = normalize_project(project_raw)?;\n        projects.push(project);\n        all_warnings.extend(warnings);\n    }\n\n    Ok((\n        ProjectsFile {\n            version: SCHEMA_VERSION.to_string(),\n            projects,\n        },\n        all_warnings,\n    ))\n}\n\n/// Load and validate `projects.yaml`. SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n                let session_id = match session_id_from {\n                    SessionIdSource::Filename => source_path\n                        .file_stem()\n                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                        .to_string(),\n                    SessionIdSource::Field(field) => {\n                        // Read first line to extract session ID (handle zst)\n                        match open_file_maybe_zst(source_path) {\n                            Ok(mut reader) => {\n                                let mut first_line = String::new();\n                                if reader.read_line(&mut first_line).is_ok() {\n                                    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&first_line) {\n                                        // Envelope-aware session ID extraction\n                                        // Check if we have envelope config\n                                        let (envelope_json, payload_json) = if let Some(\n                                            ref envelope_cfg,\n                                        ) =\n                                            plugin.source.envelope\n                                        {\n                                            let type_value =\n                                                extract_string(&json, &envelope_cfg.type_field)\n                                                    .unwrap_or_default();\n                                            let routing = envelope_cfg.get_routing(&type_value);\n\n                                            // Only extract if this line has routing\n                                            if routing == \"event\" || routing == \"meta\" {\n                                                let extracted = json\n                                                    .get(&envelope_cfg.payload_field)\n                                                    .and_then(|v| match v {\n                                                        Value::Object(_) => Some(v),\n                                                        _ => None,\n                                                    });\n                                                match extracted {\n                                                    Some(payload) => (Some(&json), payload),\n                                                    None => (None, &json),\n                                                }\n                                            } else {\n                                                (None, &json)\n                                            }\n                                        } else {\n                                            (None, &json)\n                                        };\n\n                                        extract_string_with_envelope(\n                                            field,\n                                            payload_json,\n                                            envelope_json,\n                                        )\n                                        .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string())\n                                    } else {\n                                        \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                    }\n                                } else {\n                                    \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                }\n                            }\n                            Err(_) => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n                        }\n                    }\n                };\n\n                let file_size = std::fs::metadata(source_path)?.len();\n\n                // Detect subagent sessions and extract parent_session_id from directory structure\n                // Subagent files are at: ~/.claude/projects/<path>/<parent-session-uuid>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl\n                let parent_session_id = source_path\n                    .components()\n                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                    .iter()\n                    .position(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"subagents\")\n                    .and_then(|subagents_idx| {\n                        // Parent session UUID is the component before \"subagents\"\n                        if subagents_idx > 0 {\n                            source_path\n                                .components()\n                                .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                                .get(subagents_idx - 1)\n                                .and_then(|c| c.as_os_str().to_str())\n                                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                        } else {\n                            None\n                        }\n                    });\n\n                Ok(vec![SessionInfo {\n                    session_id,\n                    start_offset: 0,\n                    end_offset: file_size,\n                    metadata: None,\n                    parent_session_id,\n                }])\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // For other detection methods, we'd need to parse the whole file\n                // For Phase 1, we only support one-file-per-session for JSONL\n                Ok(vec![])\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::parser::FormatParser;\n    use crate::plugin::{\n        LogFormat, Parser, &context.source_file,\n                        line_number,\n                        format!(\"Role field '{}' not found\", role_field),\n                    )\n                },\n            )?\n        } else {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                &context.source_file,\n                line_number,\n                \"No role field configured\".to_string(),\n            ));\n        };\n\n        // Apply role mapping\n        let role = if let Some(mapped) = plugin.parser.role_map.get(&role_str) {\n            Role::from_str(mapped).ok_or_else(|| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Invalid role mapping: {}\", mapped),\n                )\n            })?\n        } else {\n            Role::from_str(&role_str).ok_or_else(|| {\n                AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                    &context.source_file,\n                    line_number,\n                    format!(\"Invalid role: {}\", role_str),\n                )\n            })?\n        };\n\n        // Parse content (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let content = if let Some(ref content_field) = plugin.parser.content {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(content_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .unwrap_or_default()\n        } else {\n            return Err(AgentScribeError::parse_error_with_line(\n                &context.source_file,\n                line_number,\n                \"No content field configured\".to_string(),\n            ));\n        };\n\n        // Build base event\n        let mut event = Event::new(\n            ts,\n            context.session_id.clone(),\n            context.source_agent.clone(),\n            role,\n            content,\n        );\n\n        // Extract tool name if applicable (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        if role == Role::ToolCall || role == Role::ToolResult {\n            if let Some(ref tool_field) = plugin.parser.tool_name {\n                if let Some(tool_name) =\n                    extract_string_with_envelope(tool_field, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                {\n                    event.tool = Some(tool_name);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Extract tokens (envelope-aware: ^ prefix reads from wrapper, otherwise from payload)\n        let tokens_in = plugin.parser.tokens_in.as_ref().and_then(|f| {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(f, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n        });\n        let tokens_out = plugin.parser.tokens_out.as_ref().and_then(|f| {\n            extract_string_with_envelope(f, payload_json, envelope_json)\n                .and_then(|s| s.parse::<u32>().ok())\n        });\n\n        if tokens_in.is_some() || tokens_out.is_some() {\n            event.tokens = Some(TokenCounts {\n                input: tokens_in.unwrap_or(0),\n                output: tokens_out.unwrap_or(0),\n            });\n        }\n\n        // Set project from context\n        event.project = context.project.clone();\n\n        // Set model from context\n        event.model = context.model.clone();\n\n        // Add static fields\n        for (key, value) in &plugin.parser.static_fields {\n            match key.as_str() {\n                \"source_agent\" => {\n                    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {\n                        event.source_agent = s.to_string();\n                    }\n                }\n                \"source_version\" => {\n                    if let Some(s) = value.as_str() {\n                        event.source_version = Some(s.to_string());\n                    }\n                }\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Handle event expansion for compound events (e.g., Claude Code tool_use blocks)\n        // For now, return single event - expansion can be added per-agent\n        Ok(vec![event])\n    }\n}\n\nimpl super::FormatParser for JsonlParser {\n    fn parse(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<Event>> {\n        let reader = open_file_maybe_zst(source_path)?;\n        let mut events = Vec::new();\n\n        // Get session ID from filename\n        let session_id = match &plugin.source.session_detection {\n            SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n                match session_id_from {\n                    SessionIdSource::Filename => source_path\n                        .file_stem()\n                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                        .to_string(),\n                    SessionIdSource::Field(_) => {\n                        // Need to read first line to get session ID\n                        \"unknown\".to_string() // Will be updated during parsing\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            _ => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n        };\n\n        let context = ParseContext::new(\n            session_id,\n            plugin.plugin.name.clone(),\n            source_path.display().to_string(),\n        );\n\n        for (line_num, line_result) in reader.lines().enumerate() {\n            let line_num = line_num + 1;\n            let line = match line_result {\n                Ok(l) => l,\n                Err(e) => {\n                    eprintln!(\n                        \"Warning: Read error at {}:{} - {}\",\n                        source_path.display(),\n                        line_num,\n                        e\n                    );\n                    continue;\n                }\n            };\n\n            if line.trim().is_empty() {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            match JsonlParser::parse_line(&line, line_num, &context, plugin) {\n                Ok(mut line_events) => events.append(&mut line_events),\n                Err(e) => {\n                    if e.is_skippable() {\n                        eprintln!(\"Warning: {}\", e);\n                    } else {\n                        return Err(e);\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        Ok(events)\n    }\n\n    fn detect_sessions(&self, source_path: &Path, plugin: &Plugin) -> Result<Vec<SessionInfo>> {\n        // For JSONL with one-file-per-session, the file itself is the session\n        match &plugin.source.session_detection {\n            SessionDetection::OneFilePerSession { session_id_from } => {\n                let session_id = match session_id_from {\n                    SessionIdSource::Filename => source_path\n                        .file_stem()\n                        .and_then(|s| s.to_str())\n                        .unwrap_or(\"unknown\")\n                        .to_string(),\n                    SessionIdSource::Field(field) => {\n                        // Read first line to extract session ID (handle zst)\n                        match open_file_maybe_zst(source_path) {\n                            Ok(mut reader) => {\n                                let mut first_line = String::new();\n                                if reader.read_line(&mut first_line).is_ok() {\n                                    if let Ok(json) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(&first_line) {\n                                        // Envelope-aware session ID extraction\n                                        // Check if we have envelope config\n                                        let (envelope_json, payload_json) = if let Some(\n                                            ref envelope_cfg,\n                                        ) =\n                                            plugin.source.envelope\n                                        {\n                                            let type_value =\n                                                extract_string(&json, &envelope_cfg.type_field)\n                                                    .unwrap_or_default();\n                                            let routing = envelope_cfg.get_routing(&type_value);\n\n                                            // Only extract if this line has routing\n                                            if routing == \"event\" || routing == \"meta\" {\n                                                let extracted = json\n                                                    .get(&envelope_cfg.payload_field)\n                                                    .and_then(|v| match v {\n                                                        Value::Object(_) => Some(v),\n                                                        _ => None,\n                                                    });\n                                                match extracted {\n                                                    Some(payload) => (Some(&json), payload),\n                                                    None => (None, &json),\n                                                }\n                                            } else {\n                                                (None, &json)\n                                            }\n                                        } else {\n                                            (None, &json)\n                                        };\n\n                                        extract_string_with_envelope(\n                                            field,\n                                            payload_json,\n                                            envelope_json,\n                                        )\n                                        .unwrap_or_else(|| \"unknown\".to_string())\n                                    } else {\n                                        \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                    }\n                                } else {\n                                    \"unknown\".to_string()\n                                }\n                            }\n                            Err(_) => \"unknown\".to_string(),\n                        }\n                    }\n                };\n\n                let file_size = std::fs::metadata(source_path)?.len();\n\n                // Detect subagent sessions and extract parent_session_id from directory structure\n                // Subagent files are at: ~/.claude/projects/<path>/<parent-session-uuid>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl\n                let parent_session_id = source_path\n                    .components()\n                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                    .iter()\n                    .position(|c| c.as_os_str() == \"subagents\")\n                    .and_then(|subagents_idx| {\n                        // Parent session UUID is the component before \"subagents\"\n                        if subagents_idx > 0 {\n                            source_path\n                                .components()\n                                .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n                                .get(subagents_idx - 1)\n                                .and_then(|c| c.as_os_str().to_str())\n                                .map(|s| s.to_string())\n                        } else {\n                            None\n                        }\n                    });\n\n                Ok(vec![SessionInfo {\n                    session_id,\n                    start_offset: 0,\n                    end_offset: file_size,\n                    metadata: None,\n                    parent_session_id,\n                }])\n            }\n            _ => {\n                // For other detection methods, we'd need to parse the whole file\n                // For Phase 1, we only support one-file-per-session for JSONL\n                Ok(vec![])\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use crate::parser::FormatParser;\n    use crate::plugin::{\n        LogFormat, Parser,
